bioconda.name: r-snp.slicer
bioconda.summary: Bayesian nonparametric resolution of multi-strain infections
bioconda.description: Implementation of SNP-Slice, a Bayesian nonparametric method for resolving multi-strain infections using slice sampling with stick-breaking construction. The algorithm simultaneously estimates strain haplotypes and links them to hosts from sequencing data, and supports categorical, Poisson, binomial, and negative binomial observation models.
